We test whether the baseline BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON strategy meets the OP-16 edge_capture ≥ 771 threshold when evaluated on real OPRA data with OOS/WF methodology across 2026-Q3, and whether real-fills on the top-3 J anchor days remain within ±20% of BS-synthetic pricing.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The strategy trades 28 contracts on the anchor days (per playbook sizing for $25K+ account). A $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The BS-synthetic OOS/WF test covers 2026-Q3 (July–September 2026) using historical SPY/VIX bars. Selection is time-based, not walk-forward optimized; overfit risk is unknown pending real-fills validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no real OPRA OOS/WF run performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real OPRA fill validation on anchor days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day loss -$23.95 (4/29); max drawdown $4,701.52 (BS-synthetic equity curve); blow-up scenario: consecutive losing days exceeding daily loss cap.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days P&L concentration is extreme (wide_pnl = -$1,464.23, top5_pct reported as 999.0 due to negative aggregate); indicates losses are concentrated across many days rather than a few winners.
